inspectionFailed: The transaction could not be inspected — its effects are not verified.
warningSimulationFailed: The transaction simulation failed — it will likely revert on-chain.
warningTokenAccountCompromised: This transaction changes ownership, delegation or closes one of your token accounts:
warningUnexpectedSigner: This transaction requires signatures from other keys it does not already contain. Signing is blocked.
warningUnknownRecipient: This transaction sends value to an address that is not in your address book or a known FiMs address:
warningUnresolvedAccounts: Parts of this transaction could not be decoded — its intent cannot be verified. Signing is blocked.
warningUntrustedProgram: This transaction calls a program this wallet does not recognize:
warningUnverifiableChanges: Some account changes could not be verified — the shown changes may be incomplete.
warningWalletReassigned: This transaction hands control of your wallet account to another program. Signing is blocked.
